newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends off highs on late hedges, fund buy.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends off highs on late hedges, fund buy.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended up on fund buying but off the highs on late hedges, traders said.

"Funds bought about 2,000 January contracts and stopped after 1:00 p.m. so the closing hedges had few buyers," a trader said. Mar-July spread at $3, Jan-Mar $2.50, Nov-Jan $1.50. January futures crush margin fell to -41.94 from Monday's close at -34.45. Volume was heavy.

January canola rose $2.70 a tonne to $409, March up $2.80 to $411. November flax fell $2 to $365 on commercial sales as open interest was expected to decline to 500 outstanding contracts for the last trading day Wednesday, traders said.

February western barley rose $3.50 at $145 on Alberta Wheat Pool and UGG demand, commission house buy stops were triggered in the February at $145, March up $3.20 to $146. About 430 Feb-July spread at even money.
December wheat rose $2.90 to $172, March rose $2.60 to $172.30. Dec-Mar spread at $0.50.
"Longs are taking advantage of the thin volume in the wheat and there's a lack of hedges," a trader said.
Louis Dreyfus Corp sold 10 October oats down US$4 to US$113, traders said. Feed peas did not trade.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
